title: Amtrak Board of Directors - Meeting minutes | June/July 2026

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

The meeting minutes for any scheduled meeting of the Amtrak Board of Directors held during the month of June 2026 or July 2026.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Ben Heckscher

title: D.C. Health Pesticide Application & FIFRA Compliance Logs for Federal Parkland (Lot 802)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

RECORDS REQUEST PURSUANT TO D.C. FREEDOM OF INFORMATION ACT, D.C. Official Code § 2-531 et seq.

To: DOEE FOIA Officer / Department of Energy and Environment (DOEE)
From: Fred Gamble Jr., Ward 8 Community Advocate
Date: November 13, 2026

DESCRIPTION OF RECORDS SOUGHT:
Pursuant to the District of Columbia Freedom of Information Act, D.C. Official Code § 2-531 et seq., I hereby request all public records, compliance logs, pesticide application reports, interagency notices, or inspection files held by DOEE regarding any pesticide application, larvicide deployment, or vector control operations conducted by D.C. Health (including Chief of Staff Carl Filler, Director Ayanna Bennett, or any vector control personnel) at Square 5815 / Lot 802 during the period of September 1, 2026, through September 30, 2026.

This request explicitly encompasses:
1. Any restricted-use pesticide application reports or FIFRA compliance records submitted to or generated by DOEE regarding Square 5815 / Lot 802.
2. Any interagency communications, emails, transmittals, or written notices between DOEE and D.C. Health concerning chemical deployments, larvicide treatments, or vector abatement at this specific parcel.
3. Any records, manifests, or product logs referencing the chain of custody or application of larvicides (such as Bti or methoprene) at this location during September 2026.

If no responsive records exist please explicitly confirm that DOEE holds no record of any such application, report, or interagency notification from D.C. Health.

FEES AND FEE WAIVER REQUEST:
I hereby request a full waiver of all search and duplication fees pursuant to D.C. Official Code § 2-532(iv), as disclosure of the requested information is in the public interest and is likely to contribute significantly to public understanding of municipal environmental compliance, vector control operations, and public health safety in Ward 8. This request is made strictly in my capacity as a community advocate and private citizen acting on behalf of public transparency, and is not sought for commercial use.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

FRED GAMBLE JR
